items.text: The typical preparation uses 90 mL of 0.101 M Zn(OAc)₂·2H₂O in DMSO. This is the undoped reference stock; in doped preparations the zinc concentration is reduced to keep total starting metal concentration constant. A separate exact dopant mass is not reported for every characterization specimen.

items.title: Dodecylamine
items.text: Dodecylamine precipitates washed nanocrystals from DMSO and provides an intermediate capped state before TOPO processing. Its charge is missing. The source stresses removing excess Zn²⁺ first because amine otherwise causes rapid growth and poorer uniformity.

items.title: Base concentration and equivalent conventions
items.text: The typical recipe gives 0.552 M base. Figure 1a and associated prose use 0.554 M, while Figure 1b caption gives 0.552 M and its prose gives 0.554 M. The stated 30 µL into 250 µL of 0.101 M metal corresponds by curator arithmetic to about 0.658 equivalent, whereas Figure 1a calls it 0.6; Figure 4 and SI S1 instead state 0.66. These are preserved as source-specific conditions, not silently reconciled.

items.title: Why the band edge responds to dopant magnetization
items.text: The Co bandgap MCD follows the S = 3/2 magnetization of isolated Co dopants, which the authors interpret as exchange-induced semiconductor magnetization.
